title: Applications turn into offers
hook: Two stated cases: explore search activity and conditional offer probabilities.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How search activity and conditional offer probabilities affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Purchases, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare search activity and conditional offer probabilities in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Of 10 toy visitors, fraction 0.8 stop and fraction 0.2 of those buy. How many purchases are expected?
